## Language

Name the language and Whereabouts version used as the source.

## Change

List the affected keys or attach the corrected translation file. Change only the text on the right side of each tab and preserve the keys on the left.

## Review status

- [ ] Checked for the required encoding and line format
- [ ] Loaded successfully in Skyrim
- [ ] Reviewed by a fluent or native speaker

Tell us which checks were not performed. See [Translating Whereabouts](https://github.com/Soulslyly/Whereabouts/blob/main/docs/TRANSLATING.md) for the complete format.
